hypothesis: An observation-only two-run LibNC execution can materialize a byte-identical, complete 32-stream production update fixture at block position 256, including every dense gradient and all pre/post parameter, optimizer, memory, batch, learning-rate, and train-step state required by an open parity successor.

kill_condition: Missing, unnamed, sparse, reordered, or non-repeating gradients; incomplete pre/post state; schedule drift; geometry drift; or source-identity drift prevents promotion and forbids a second-segment claim.
promotion_condition: The full fixture is byte-identical across fresh runs, contains 246 named dense gradients, binds all 32 streams and 20 layers, and advances the frozen boundary exactly from block 256/train step 4 to block 320/train step 5.
retired_neighborhoods: No open backward, optimizer parity, second-segment, compression, or score claim follows from the teacher fixture alone.
title: Complete production update oracle fixture
